BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to state route number 527; and amending RCW47.17.745.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 47.17.745 and 1970 ex.s. c 51 s 150 are each amendedto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: A state highway to be known as state route number 527 isestablished as follows: Beginning at a junction with state route number ((522)) 405 in thevicinity of Bothell, thence northerly to a junction with state routenumber 5 in ((the vicinity south of)) Everett.
